<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_transform_map"><sys_transform_map action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><copy_empty_fields>false</copy_empty_fields><create_new_record_on_empty_coalesce_fields>false</create_new_record_on_empty_coalesce_fields><enforce_mandatory_fields>No</enforce_mandatory_fields><name>LDAP CorpUsers Import</name><order>100</order><run_business_rules>true</run_business_rules><run_script>true</run_script><script><![CDATA[//
// The manager coming in from LDAP is the DN value for the manager.  
// The line of code below will locate the manager that matches the
// DN value and set it into the target record. To ignore the manager 
// from LDAP, remove or comment out the line: ldapUtils.setManager(source, target);
//
// NOTE: The 'manager' field SHOULD NOT be mapped in the 'Field Maps' related list
// if the manager is brought in through an LDAP import.  The 'ldapUtils' scripts
// here and in the 'onComplete' Transform Map will map this value automatically.
ldapUtils.setManager(source, target);

// Set the source LDAP server into the target record
target.ldap_server = source.sys_import_set.data_source.ldap_target.server;

if (target.email && source.mail) {
    target.email = source.mail;  // always keep AD email
}]]></script><source_table>x_1808462_mysdesk_corpusers_import</source_table><sys_class_name>sys_transform_map</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-09-04 14:12:37</sys_created_on><sys_id>e41c025d937f625005b6367efaba1066</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>LDAP CorpUsers Import</sys_name><sys_package display_value="MyServiceDesk" source="x_1808462_mysdesk">bcb2fd1c935ba25005b6367efaba10ed</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="MyServiceDesk">bcb2fd1c935ba25005b6367efaba10ed</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_transform_map_e41c025d937f625005b6367efaba1066</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-09-15 18:54:51</sys_updated_on><target_table>sys_user</target_table></sys_transform_map></record_update>
